# CRM-2 Deals, Pipeline and Quotes — Data Dictionary

**Scope:** V1 / issue #16. Owner: CRM-2. All tables live in PostgreSQL schema `crm2`. UUIDs are generated by PostgreSQL. Timestamps use `timestamptz` and default to `now()`.

## `crm2.crm2_stages`

| Field | Type | Nullability | Meaning | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | UUID | NOT NULL | Stable stage identifier | Primary key |
| `name` | TEXT | NOT NULL | Fixed stage label | One of New, Qualified, Proposal, Negotiation, Won, Lost; unique |
| `position` | SMALLINT | NOT NULL | Display order from 1 to 6 | Unique; range 1–6 |
| `is_won` | BOOLEAN | NOT NULL | Whether this is the successful terminal stage | True only for Won |

The migration seeds the six approved stages with stable IDs. The database rejects stage updates and deletes. The API must expose stages as read-only; stage insertion is reserved for controlled migrations.

## `crm2.crm2_deals`

| Field | Type | Nullability | Meaning | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | UUID | NOT NULL | Deal identifier | Primary key |
| `name` | TEXT | NOT NULL | Deal name | Must not be blank |
| `contact_id` | UUID | NULL | Contact reference from CRM-1 | No cross-schema FK; nullable so orphan deals can be shown and warned about |
| `value` | NUMERIC(14,2) | NOT NULL | Deal value | Non-negative decimal; never floating point |
| `currency` | TEXT | NOT NULL | Currency code | Exactly three uppercase letters |
| `stage_id` | UUID | NOT NULL | Current sales stage | FK to `crm2.crm2_stages.id`; deletion restricted |
| `close_date` | DATE | NULL | Expected or actual close date | Optional |
| `source_system` | TEXT | NULL | Origin system for imported deal | Paired with source_id; pair unique |
| `source_id` | TEXT | NULL | Stable identifier in origin system | Paired with source_system; pair unique |
| `created_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL | Creation time | Defaults to now() |
| `updated_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL | Last update time | Defaults to now(); writers refresh on update |

Indexes support case-insensitive name search, contact lookup, stage filtering and close-date lookup. Contact existence is checked through CRM-1's public reference resolver, not a cross-schema foreign key.

## `crm2.crm2_quotes`

| Field | Type | Nullability | Meaning | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | UUID | NOT NULL | Quote identifier | Primary key |
| `quote_number` | TEXT | NOT NULL | Human-readable quote number | Non-blank and unique |
| `deal_id` | UUID | NOT NULL | Parent deal | FK to `crm2.crm2_deals.id`; deletion restricted |
| `quote_date` | DATE | NOT NULL | Date the quote was issued | Required |
| `amount` | NUMERIC(14,2) | NOT NULL | Quote amount | Non-negative decimal |
| `note` | TEXT | NULL | Optional note | Optional |
| `source_system` | TEXT | NULL | Origin system for imported quote | Paired with source_id; pair unique |
| `source_id` | TEXT | NULL | Stable identifier in origin system | Paired with source_system; pair unique |
| `created_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL | Creation time | Defaults to now() |
| `updated_at` | TIMESTAMPTZ | NOT NULL | Last update time | Defaults to now(); writers refresh on update |

Indexes support deal and quote-date lookups.

## Domain and boundary rules

- V1 stages are exactly New, Qualified, Proposal, Negotiation, Won and Lost. No forecasting or drag-and-drop board.
- `contact_id` is nullable. The UI must visibly warn when it is absent; it must not silently hide an orphan deal.
- CRM-2 owns all writes to its tables. The Migration Kit must load through the approved CRM-2 adapter/API, not direct SQL writes to target tables.
- Cross-module contact references are resolved through CRM-1's public facade. No cross-schema foreign key is permitted.
- All fixtures and test data must be synthetic.
- Source-system/source-id pairs are both null or both non-blank. Duplicate source pairs are rejected.
- Monetary values use `NUMERIC(14,2)` to avoid floating-point rounding errors.
